name: Blue satin inverted-V tie tab (USAF style)
size_basis: Shape and colour are as the regulation names them (blue, USAF-style inverted V with self-fastening tails; 4.2.4.3, 4.2.6.3). The regulation gives no dimensions: 2.7 in wide by 1.6 in tall with 0.7 in legs is an estimate matched to the collar opening of the base shirts.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: blue satin inverted-V tie tab with self-fastening tails (4.1.2.2.1, 4.2.4.3)
worn with the aviator shirt or a white collared blouse; not with a turtleneck or shell (4.2.4.3)
mandatory with the women's long-sleeve blue blouse, optional with the short sleeve (4.1.12.4)
